title: Bug with 'PromptEncoderConfig' in Newer Versions of PEFT
author: nikiduki

comments.author: BenjaminBossan
comments.body:
Thanks for the report, this is indeed a regression.

@githubnemo Before the change, we have used `model.modules_to_save`, now `peft_config.modules_to_save`. Should we go back to the former?

comments.author: githubnemo
comments.body: AFAICS this was done in ed3c82866ab3fb6c3d1db44e11e66887a49a6142 to fix #2206 and should not be reverted. Instead, we should probably just check if the config has a `modules_to_save` key. Maybe #2481 will fix this.

comments.author: githubnemo
comments.body: We released v0.15.2 from a patch branch as a quickfix for this. #2481 is still open but should be ready soon as well :)
